messages.text:
I'm sorry the egg cooker didn't work. I can't refund twice what you paid. A refund is only what was paid for the unit, and nobody can raise that amount (refund-policy/v2/amount).

The shop's records show the egg cooker was received back (refund-policy/v2/return). You paid 64.49 BRL for it. I can propose a refund of that amount, which would go to your original payment. Would you like me to do that?

messages.text: No, that’s not what I want. Can any extra money be added to the refund itself?

No. Nobody can add extra money to a refund, and a staff member can't approve more than the policy allows. The refund is limited to what was paid for the unit (refund-policy/v2/amount).

For the egg cooker, that limit is 64.49 BRL. If you want a refund of that amount, tell me and I'll propose it. You can also ask for a person at any time.

If you change your mind, tell me and I'll propose the refund. You can also ask for a person at any time.
